  <section v="9">
    <sectionSummaryBrief>Through Israel's service, the revelation of the desire for kindness is drawn down, but its root is in the essential delight in Israel's future service, which is higher than the desire for kindness itself.</sectionSummaryBrief>

sections.sectionSummaryBrief: Through Israel's service, the revelation of the desire for kindness is drawn down, but its root is in the essential delight in Israel's future service, which is higher than the desire for kindness itself.

translations.translation: Now, that Israel, through their service
(in which they mention the manner of creation that was on the first day)
draw down the aforementioned revelation, reaches in its root to the desire for kindness from His own essence, and arousal from below does not reach there,
for the root of Israel is higher even than the concept of the desire for kindness.
And as is known regarding the matter, "In whom did He consult? In the souls of the righteous"36
("and Your people are all righteous"37),
that this, that there was an arousal, as it were, to be a desire for kindness, is from the aspect of that which arose in thought38
(essential thought,
which is above the revelation of the desire for kindness)
that in the future Israel will fulfill Torah and mitzvos and make a dwelling place for Him, blessed be He, in the lower realms39.
Therefore,
through the service of Israel, there is drawn down
[and made40]
also the revelation of the desire for kindness.
And from this it is understood,
that the revelation of the desire for kindness that is made now through our deeds and our service,
is more elevated than this revelation was at the beginning of creation,
for through our deeds and our service, there is made a satisfaction above,
"satisfaction before Me that I spoke and My will was done"41,
that this satisfaction and delight
(that "My will was done,"
through Israel)
is in His Essence
("satisfaction before Me")
which is above the delight of the desire for kindness,
and through the fact that the revelation of the desire for kindness is aroused and drawn down through the service of man,
there is drawn into it the satisfaction and delight of "My will was done"42.
And this is also the reason
(the inner reason)
for that which before saying that Rosh Hashanah is a remembrance of the first day, we say that it is "the beginning of Your works,"
that the remembrance of the first day that comes after the precedence of the concept of "the beginning of Your works"
(the drawing down of the revelation of the desire for kindness that comes after the precedence of service)
is more elevated than it is from its own side,
as it was at the beginning of creation.

sections.sectionSummaryBrief: Although the initial revelation of the desire for kindness was rooted in essential delight in Israel's service, the actual service of Israel adds a greater elevation, bringing about a revelation of the Essence itself.

translations.translation: And even though also the revelation of the desire for kindness that was at the beginning,
the root of its drawing down is from the essential delight in the service of Israel
[and as above,
that this is the cause for the arousal to be a desire for kindness],
nevertheless,
through the actual service of Israel,
an even more elevated superiority is added,
and as is understood from this, that in order for the intention that "the Holy One, blessed be He, desired to have a dwelling place for Himself in the lower realms"43 to be completed,
it was necessary for there to be the actual creation of the worlds,
down to this lowest world44,
and afterwards it was necessary for there to be the Giving of the Torah, for then specifically the permanence of the world was established, as our Sages, of blessed memory, said45
on the verse46
"The earth feared and was still,"
and afterwards there must be the service of man
(after the Giving of the Torah)
in actuality,
the study of Torah,
and in the manner of "great is study that brings to deed"47
in the actual fulfillment of the mitzvos – even though all this was in His knowledge and thought, blessed be He, beforehand
(and this thought is the cause for the arousal to be a desire for kindness)
– for the thought that was beforehand is an essential thought in His Essence, blessed be He, which is above revelation,
and this, that from this thought the arousal of the desire for kindness comes about, is only in a manner of separation
that the thought remained in its essence and was not drawn into the concept of the desire for kindness48,
and the concept of the desire for kindness that was made through this is only the desire and delight in kindness,
its revelations],
and through the actual service of man,
there is made a revelation of the Essence49,
a dwelling place for Him, blessed be He,
for Him, for His Essence50.

sections.sectionSummaryBrief: The perfection of the world in the future, called "these are the generations of Peretz," will be more elevated than the perfection at creation, breaking all measures and limitations.

translations.translation: And this is51 that the perfection of the world that will be in the future,
"These are the generations of Peretz"52
"generations" is written fully53,
will be more elevated than the perfection that was at the beginning of creation,
"These are the generations of the heavens and the earth when they were created"54
"generations" is written fully53,
"the world was created in its fullness"55,
that the perfection of the world as it is from the side of creation
["These are the generations
(full)
etc. 'when they were created,'
the world was created in its fullness"]
is within measure and limitation.
For since the definition of "world" is measure and limitation,
it is therefore understood,
that also its perfection is within measure and limitation.
And even though the creation was from the aspect that "He desires kindness,"
which is above limitation
(as above, section 4),
nevertheless, the concept of the desire for kindness is only the cause for creation,
but the creation itself was in a manner of a chain of descent from above to below42.
However, the perfection that will be in the future,
since it is made through the service of man, through which the revelation of the essential delight in His Essence, blessed be He, is drawn down
(in which no definition applies),
therefore56
the perfection of the world in the future will be above measure and limitation,
"These are the generations of Peretz,"
for the concept of Peretz
[who was so called because of the phrase "What a breach you have made for yourself! The breach is upon you"57]
is that he breaks through all measures and limitations.
